Looking for an international environment? Do you possess strong B2B communication skills? Then this technical support role within the medical device sector is looking for you! Here in Machelen, you will be handling incoming communication from internal and external stakeholders and be responsible for:

• Following strict internal guidelines to ensure a high level of reporting quality for medical matters.

• Processing and updating projects in SAP.

• Monitoring POs and shipments.

• Escalating more complex problems to the specific departments, which could be regarding accounting or more technical issues. It depends on the problem!

• Logging and archiving of reports and contracts.

• Backup for other administrative tasks.

 

• You communicate fluently in English AND Italian or Spanish.

• In possession of a university degree and a Belgian working permit

• Experience within larger company structures is a plus.

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about keeping things running smoothly? As a Carfleet Admin Support, you’ll be the driving force behind the efficient management of a company’s vehicle fleet. From coordinating maintenance and tracking vehicle performance to managing documentation and assisting drivers, you’ll ensure everything stays on the road and on schedule. Your problem-solving skills and proactive approach will help prevent delays and keep operations moving seamlessly. 

You will join a dynamic Corporate Operations Management Team and provide support with the administration and coordination of the car fleet across 10 European countries.

Your responsibilities as a Carfleet Admin Support:

• Handle day-to-day fleet administration such as vehicle orders, fuel management, mileage analysis.

• Manage incoming emails and invoice checks.

• Act as the first point of contact for drivers and suppliers across multiple countries regarding general enquiries and questions  via phone and email.

• Support the team with various operational and administrative tasks as needed.

As a Carfleet Admin Support you have following skills: 

• University degree (or equivalent relevant work experience)

• Proven work experience in an administrative role

• Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

• Clear communication skills and good time management.

• Business proficiency in English; proficiency in any of the following languages is a big plus: Czech, Dutch, French, German, Polish, Romanian, Slovak, Slovenian or Hungarian.

• Driving license required.

• Good knowledge of MS Office.

• A team player with an international mindset.

• Available for an interim contract of 18 months

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.
This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.
One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)
The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:
You are flexible
You are able to do physical work 
You can work well in a team
You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

- Talenkennis:
English

Do you enjoy working with a forklift and appreciate order? This forklift operator position allows you to support the entire production process. 

You make sure raw materials and finished products are always in the right place to keep operations running smoothly.Your typical day starts by checking your forklift. You supply the necessary materials according to the production schedule and safely store finished goods in the designated locations.

Does this job sound interesting? Apply quickly and make a difference as a forklift operator!

• You have experience as a forklift operator or in a similar role
• You speak fluent Dutch, English, or French
• You work safely and precisely
• You take initiative to report problems or defects
• You are willing to work in two shifts

We are looking for a Machine Operator (Carpentry) for a company that specializes in making caskets!

What will your responsibilities be?

• Planing and sawing products
• Operating the gluing machine
• Conducting quality checks on products
• Operating a forklift
Work hours: 12:30 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.

Who are you?

• You’re open to physical work
• Forklift experience or a certificate is a plus
• You speak Dutch, English, or Polish
• You’re open to working a fixed afternoon shift
• You have your own transportation

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You oversee the production process and, together with your team, ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

 
• 
You monitor the operation of 3 automatic packaging machines

 
• 
You manage 3 operators and 2 forklift drivers and provide guidance throughout their work

 
• 
You actively work on the machines yourself and step in wherever needed

 
• 
You set up, monitor, and adjust the packaging machines

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, safety, efficiency, and production planning

 
• 
You carry out checks on products and packaging

 
• 
You identify malfunctions and deviations and resolve them yourself whenever possible

 
• 
You ensure an efficient distribution of tasks and clear communication within the team

 
• 
You are the first point of contact for employees on the production floor

Do you know automatic packaging lines inside out, enjoy taking a hands-on approach, and at the same time know how to keep an overview of both your team and the production process? Then this Team Leader position could be a great fit for you.

 
• 
Experience working with an automatic packaging line is essential

 
• 
You have strong technical insight and a hands-on mentality

 
• 
Experience with CPS, multihead weighers, checkweighers, metal detection systems and/or automatic stackers is an advantage

 
• 
Experience managing or coordinating a team is an asset

 
• 
You have natural leadership skills and the maturity required to take responsibility

 
• 
You have good organisational and communication skills

 
• 
You communicate very well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is essential, as you will be managing operators and forklift drivers who speak Dutch, English, or French

BMSvision is not just another tech company; they are your go-to partner for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in the discrete manufacturing industry, with a specific focus on the textile, plastics and packaging industries. Their highly skilled R&D experts are passionate about developing top-notch hardware and software solutions that register productivity, quality and energy consumption data. This empowers their customers to fine-tune their operations for optimal efficiency.

Established in 2008 as a spin-off by Barco and currently part of the Vandewiele group, the BMSvision team has gained substantial experience learning from a large installed base in the plastics and textile industry. Their MES-solutions seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, addressing the requirements of Industry 4.0 and the broader Smart Factory landscape.

They’ve established their presence in Belgium (HQ), the UK, the US, China, India, Malaysia and Turkey. Additionally, they’ve built a worldwide network of agents and service centers.

Jobomschrijving

Drive international growth by helping manufacturers succeed in their Industry 4.0 journey

• You will be responsible for selling MES-systems to B2B customers in the global growth markets of textiles and plastics.
• You focus on medium and large enterprises and you'll speak to strategic decision makers (owners, general management, IT and production management).
• In the countries where you operate, you will work together with sales agents. You research the market potential of your countries, select quality partners with a good reputation, evaluate their activities and visit prospects whose doors they will open.
• You are responsible for preparing offers, launching marketing campaigns and making presentations.
• You participate in national and international fairs.
• You think along with the customer and convince them that BMS is their suitable partner for their Industry 4.0 strategy.

• You hold a technical or technical/economic master’s degree or you've built up equivalent expertise through experience and you have a strong affinity with software-driven solutions.
• Ideally, you bring around 10 years of experience in Sales or Business Development, preferably within the manufacturing industry, where you have successfully positioned business operations or MES-related software.
• You feel at ease collaborating with stakeholders at different levels and you have a proven track record in complex, project-driven sales environments with longer sales cycles.
• You love to travel internationally frequently and you are interested in other cultures.
• You communicate fluently in English and any additional language skills, such as French, German, Italian, etc., are a strong asset.
• Continuous learning energizes you. You enjoy negotiating, building long-term relationships and taking ownership.
• You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong self-management skills, all within a collaborative corporate culture where pragmatism, intrapreneurship and responsibility truly matter.

As Valuer Advisor Assistant, you will support our Valuer Advisors in the valuation of real estate. You are responsible for the preparation, analysis and reporting within the valuation process.
You are part of a team working around one type of real estate (logistics, offices, retail, residential, leisure, healthcare, ...) and you work closely with the other members of this Business Unit.

Your responsibilities:

• File management & preparatory administration
You will support the team in file distribution and further start-up of files. For this, you prepare documents such as appraisal reports and valuation files.
• Processing Sales Requests
Quotation requests reach you by phone or mail and are processed by you. You learn to make price calculations, and answer the requests with quotations, which you actively follow up. You will also request additional information from clients where necessary and ensure that all documents are sent correctly and on time. For larger files, you will help prepare pitches, large quotations and framework agreements
• Ad-hoc Support & Portfolio Updates
You will be the point of contact for a variety of ad-hoc tasks, such as updating client portfolios or processing data. Creating and structuring files in our computer systems is also part of your responsibilities. You provide broad administrative support, also for internal projects such as studies and app development. You support valuer advisors by conducting site visits. 
• You have a bachelor's degree in administration, real estate/an equivalent field or have accumulated equivalent knowledge/experience through projects and work experience.
• You work accurately, independently, efficiently and with an eye for detail
• You are proactive and enjoy planning and structuring
• You communicate and write fluently in Dutch and English as you have regular contact with customers and colleagues. Knowledge of French is a plus.
• You are familiar with MS Office and quickly learn new tools.
• You dare to ask questions and enjoy learning.
We recruit based on competencies and talents, regardless of age, sex, gender, origin or limitation/disability.
 We offer
• An impactful position in which you will actively help build the future of Stadim
• An attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits (insurance, bonus...)
• Internal on-the-job training given by experienced colleagues
• An informal, collegial work environment with room for initiative
• A genuine commitment to work-life balance
• A challenging entry-level position with growth opportunities towards Valuer Advisor

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team.

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. If you have solid GMP  experience (ideally in production or close to production) and you naturally take ownership, coordinate smoothly, and feel comfortable guiding others, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:
	
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.	
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.	
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.	
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.	
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.	
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality.

Who we are looking for: 
	
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 	
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .	
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.	
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities:	
• you take ownership	
• you guide and support others confidently	
• you keep oversight and work in a structured way	
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.	
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.

• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
